pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown regions exhibit complex, stellate geometries with jagged, acute-angled edges. Individual patches display high-frequency pixel gradients along the borders, creating a leaf-like or star-shaped appearance across the flank and lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space forms a continuous, high-density network of narrow pathways. Junction nodes are characterized by multiple intersecting lines meeting at sharp, irregular angles. Pathway thickness is relatively thin and uniform throughout the visible mid-section.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck exhibits a continuous, low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile against the sky. The silhouette is composed of fine, closely-spaced textural protrusions.
